text_block_list.text:
Peeking into the dance studio, I saw 
Bubble Gum Fellow and Fuji Kiseki 
earnestly doing dance training together.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: One, two... Let's match our steps here!
choice_data_list: Are you two having a lesson together?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ah, they're quite well-coordinated, right? 
Fuji and I share the same teacher, you 
see.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I started taking lessons first, and then 
Bubble followed along, you know?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Simply put, I guess that makes us fellow 
apprentices, right?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Then let's put on a great dance and make 
Sensei proud, as fellow disciples!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Of course! If there's anything you notice, 
don't hesitate to speak up.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, let's pick up from where we 
left off!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Phew... It's really coming together 
nicely!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Fuji. That top-class 
dancing skill at the academy isn't just 
for show.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"As a junior disciple, there was so much 
for me to learn from her— it was such 
great inspiration!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, that goes for me too. I'm 
always truly amazed by how quickly you 
improve, Bubble."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I can't afford to space out either!
choice_data_list:
Not just Trainer, the fans are gonna love 
how this turned out!

Not just Trainer, the fans will love how 
this turned out too!

They supported each other just like real 
sisters.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I can't afford to space out either!
choice_data_list:
Not just Trainer, the fans are gonna love 
how this turned out!

Not just Trainer, the fans will love how 
this turned out too!

They supported each other just like real 
sisters.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, I'm so glad to hear you say that.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Good work to you too, Bubble. Here, this 
is a reward for working so hard today.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Could that be!? Is it the limited-edition 
Hachimi Milk Caramel flavor?!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I brought something super sweet for you.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
As expected of my senior disciple! You 
really know me so well!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
True, you two were in complete sync. Why 
not try doing something as a pair?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Sounds good! Sounds like fun!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Let's show everyone! A dance between 
fellow disciples!
